limitations.text: The permanent Resident model is still awaiting qualification and Resident-dependent acceptance.
No packaged desktop installer is certified by this source-release record.
Capability Fabric v0.1 runtime is not shipped in this candidate.
Model-neutral delegation runtime is not shipped in this candidate.
The separate Luna skills-loader semantic change is not included in the immutable candidate.
GGUF artifacts are not bundled in the source checkout; local model readiness requires an installed compatible runtime and model artifact.
DPAPI/desktop-list, DAP/debugpy, LSP, and other environment-dependent checks retain their documented platform or tool prerequisites.
The candidate retains documented architecture-decision waivers for selected legacy chat/model routes.
External providers require explicit enrollment and consent; local operation remains the default.
Kimi live proof was blocked on the certification machine by missing entitlement.
The desktop/Tauri transitive glib issue remains a separate packaging-lane investigation and is not a source-core certification claim.
The source-release SBOM, provenance manifest, release manifest, and SHA-256 checksums are generated in the separate assembly artifact set and must be refreshed if the release input changes.
